_scope: Stage 1 of the Page-2 decision, TIER 20 ONLY (minCandidateCount < 40). Three nodes: Resolve Search Tier (page 1 only), Expand Phase 2 Queries (page 1 only; do not re-send a query phase 1 got an answer for; re-send once a query that got no answer), Merge Serp Results (Tier 20: records phase-1 answered/failed queries in static data, and closes a phase 1 that found no LinkedIn profile at all with an explicit completion; all tiers: a per-call serpStats line on its output). Tier 40 behaves exactly as today - same queries, pages, phase-2 settings, static data and completions; its only difference is the inert serpStats field on Merge's output (Split Out keeps only organic_results; Prepare Complete Search builds its body field by field), kept deliberately so Tier 40's pages 2-5 are monitored. No change to Prepare Serp Pages, the SerpAPI node, the query texts, bag-of-words, enrichment, scoring, the threshold or billing.

_retryNotRetryOnFail: n8n's retryOnFail is deliberately NOT enabled on the SerpAPI node. Read from n8n-core on the server (workflow-execute.js): the retry check is isErrorValue(data.data[0][0].json.error) on the node's raw output - the FIRST item only. The routing node stores a per-call connection error as {json: {}, error} at that point (routing-node.js), and n8n rewrites it to {json: {error: message}, error} only afterwards, before child nodes run. So a connection error is retried only by accident - when item 0 happens to be a Google 'no results' answer, which then re-runs the whole node against SerpAPI's cache (exec 2024's phase 1 had exactly that shape). The retry therefore lives in phase 2: a phase-1 query that got no answer is sent once more (SerpAPI does not bill a failed call). It fires only when phase 2 starts, i.e. phase 1 delivered at least one candidate.
_expectedEffect: A full Tier-20 search goes from 10 SerpAPI calls (8 billed + 2 cache hits) to 4 billed calls: phase 1 two queries x page 1; phase 2 the planned queries that phase 1 did not answer (for most titles bag-of-words + the no-AND title query; titles containing 'support', 'helpdesk', 'engineer' or the letters 'it ' get the pre-existing IT-Support/Engineer query instead - e.g. 'Audit Manager', a separate stage-2 fix). A search that stops after phase 1 goes from 4 calls to 2. Plus one retry per phase-1 query that failed to connect. Delivered candidates lost in the retained runs since the regime change: 0 (execs 2033-2041, Tier 20). Replaying the patched phase-2 query set on the 11 retained Tier-20 runs that had a phase 2 (recorded page-1 answers, today's Filter New URLs rules): no run falls to 0 new profiles; the minimum is 4 (exec 1916); new non-foreign phase-2 profiles fall in 5 of the 11 (1913 19->6, 1917 11->5, 2024 9->5, 2032 18->14, 2041 7->5) - all of them from page 2 or the repeat, i.e. from the pre-regime-change runs or non-delivered.
_notDone: Page 2 cannot be monitored once it is not requested: serpStats records page-1 health (and Tier 40's pages 2-5), not a page-2 comeback - a sparse page-2 probe is a separate owner decision. Replacing the freed calls with new, measured page-1 queries is stage 2, as is the 'it ' substring in the IT-Support rule. Pre-existing and unchanged: a PHASE 2 that finds no new LinkedIn profile, or a phase whose profiles are all dropped by Filter New URLs, still ends without a completion; this patch never hands phase 2 an empty query list (it falls back to today's first query), which keeps parity but does not close that path. Workflow static data is ~255 KB, mostly lingering hhCandidates - its own ticket.

_zeroProfilePhase1: Without page 2 a Tier-20 phase 1 can end with no LinkedIn profile at all: 1 of 21 retained runs (exec 2024: page 1 = one 'no results' + one connection error; all 19 profiles came from page 2). Nothing downstream runs on an empty list (n8n schedules children only for non-empty output; no node on the path has alwaysOutputData), so the search would end without a completion and the recruiter would see a spinner until the page gives up after 10 minutes. Merge Serp Results now closes such a Tier-20 search through the existing __completeOnly path (the one 'every page failed' already uses): searchFailed true with the count of failed requests when any call failed, otherwise 'No LinkedIn profiles found for this search.' Nothing is billed: no candidate was sent.
